answer: Sybil resistance employs a Proof-of-Stake mechanism where each AI agent stakes native tokens, acting as a financial beacon of legitimate identity. An attacker creating fake identities must acquire and bond tokens for each. This economic barrier makes scaling attacks prohibitively expensive. Trust in this system is not a relic of centralized authority, but a continuously verified economic commitment, making reaching the zenith of network influence through Sybils an unachievable feat.
